heading: Streamline interface for quick access to delivery tasks and enhance data visualization for key performance metrics.
eyebrow: 👩‍💻 In order to understand more about the industry, I conduct the competitive analysis.

blocks.html: I conducted an analysis of the top courier apps in Japan and other countries, taking into account the unique requirements of the Japanese market to gain valuable insights and identify opportunities. We explored various product concepts and business scenarios to understand the similarities and differences.

blocks.alt: Espoirer — Streamline interface for quick access to delivery tasks and enhance data visualization for key performance metrics.

blocks.html: I gather as many pieces of “inspiration” as possible and examine what our competitors and similar applications do. We conduct the feature research by consolidating screenshots and annotating key components.

blocks.alt: Espoirer — Streamline interface for quick access to delivery tasks and enhance data visualization for key performance metrics.

blocks.html: By identifying relevant features that our competitors are using to enhance delivery efficiency, we gained the insights.
🔍 Scan: Enhance package scanning efficiency with actionable feedback, optimize routes through data analytics, and provide a search function for problematic barcodes.
📦 Task: Organized package displays and map integration for task management, enable delivery tracking through filters and allow drivers to customize their routes.
📊 Analytics: Enhance user efficiency by focusing on data visualization and visual hierarchy in dashboards for clear, accessible overviews and detailed metrics.
